# Tappsk - ToDo & Habit Tracker (App Store ID 1385049326) — Full Review Analysis

**MATVEY KONDAKOV · `com.tappsk.ios` · Productivity, Lifestyle · free download with a capped free tier; Premium sold as a monthly or annual subscription and as a one-time lifetime unlock, with a 7-day trial and frequent lifetime discounts**

Every one of the **15,176 reviews** in `reviews.jsonl` was read individually, in its original language, and hand-coded. Nothing was sampled, keyword-filtered or skipped. Corpus: **2018-10-14 → 2026-09-05** (just under eight years), **109 storefronts**, **24 languages plus emoji-only reviews** (Russian 11,548, English 1,457, Portuguese 578, German 347, French 323, Arabic 202, Spanish 128, Ukrainian 115, and 17 more), corpus mean **4.60★**.

---

## How to read this

- Every quantified claim carries **count, percentage, denominator, scope, period, signal band and review IDs**. Signal bands are those in `Store Review Analysis Prompt.md`.
- Theme counts are **non-exclusive**: a review carrying five ideas is counted in five themes. Percentages are *shares of reviews mentioning a thing* and sum past 100%.
- **§10 is a complete per-review index.** Any number here resolves to exact reviews; any review resolves to the findings it supports via §9.J.
- Review IDs appear as `` `3300153411` `` (the `review_id` in `reviews.jsonl`) and as `#1` (position in date order, 1…15,176). Both appear in §10.
- Quotations are verbatim and short. Non-English text is quoted in the original with a translation. `…` marks an elision.
- Global percentages use **all 15,176 reviews**, from every storefront.

### ⚠️ Seven warnings before any number here is used

1. **This is a praise corpus, and a Russian one.** 5★ 12,122 (79.88%), 1–2★ 902 (5.94%). Any-praise reviews are 76.58%. The Russian storefront holds 10,667 reviews (70.29%) and 11,548 reviews (76.09%) are written in Russian. Global findings are therefore dominated by Russian-speaking users; §6 separates the other storefronts.
2. **Eight years, several pricing regimes.** The free tier was cut in 2021-01 (`MON_FREE_CUT` 103, 80 of them in 2021-01→04), App Store payment became unavailable to most Russian users from 2022-03 (`MON_PAYMENT_METHOD` 74), and a direct-card checkout later appears in praise. Themes are dated; §7 separates six eras.
3. **Trial charges drive the 1★ band.** `MON_AUTO_CHARGE` **229** reviews (1.51%); 163 of the 674 1★ reviews carry it. Whether a charge was early, expected or refunded is the reviewer's account; purchases cannot be verified.
4. **Rating prompts shape the corpus.** `REV_SOLICITED` **309** reviews (2.04%) name the in-app prompt, most of them its "let the developers be sad" dismiss button. 14 days carry 20 or more reviews (324 reviews, 2.13%). §7.6 recomputes the headlines without them; §9.H reports the authenticity checks, including a 2020-04 cluster of reviews about a different app.
5. **Short reviews.** 3,701 bodies (24.39%) have 30 characters or fewer; many are coded `PR_GENERIC` or `PR_EASY` only. `NOISE` 103 reviews carry no usable content; `WRONG_APP` 20 describe another product.
6. **Star and text sometimes disagree.** `CONTRA_RATING` **155** reviews, **1.02%** of 15,176; they are coded by their text (§4.3). Several 5★ reviews are support tickets asking for a refund.
7. **Codes are hand judgement.** Each line in the classification file quotes the text behind its codes (§1.4); nothing was assigned by keyword or model. Outcomes and purchases are self-reported.

# PART 0 — READ THIS FIRST

The eight findings that should change a decision.

## 0.1 One screen, tasks and habits together: the praise is about ease, not power

`U_PRAISE_ANY` **11622** reviews, **76.58%** of 15,176 — High-priority signal, mean 4.86★, 2018-10-14 → 2026-09-05. The single largest reason is ease: `U_EASE` **4927** reviews, **32.47%** of 15,176 — High-priority signal (`PR_EASY` **3824** reviews, **25.20%** of 15,176; `PR_SIMPLE` **1704** reviews, **11.23%** of 15,176; `PR_FAST` **125** reviews, **0.82%** of 15,176; `PR_ONE_SCREEN` **82** reviews, **0.54%** of 15,176). Next come design (`PR_DESIGN` **1457** reviews, **9.60%** of 15,176), "better than the others I tried" (`PR_BETTER_THAN` **1307** reviews, **8.61%** of 15,176) and thanks to the developer (`PR_DEV` **1244** reviews, **8.20%** of 15,176). The combination users name as the differentiator is tasks and habits on one screen: `PR_ALLINONE` **293** reviews, **1.93%** of 15,176, `PR_HABITS` **445** reviews, **2.93%** of 15,176.

> "Задачи и привычки в одном приложении - гениально" — #97, `4091270637`, ru, 5★
> *(translation: tasks and habits in one app — genius)*

> "настолько простое и интуитивно понятно что в него хочется постоянно заходить" — #5000, `7442129872`, ru, 5★
> *(translation: so simple and intuitive that you want to keep opening it)*

> "Я попробовал все основные планировщики на рынке, по сравнению с Tappsk они просто мрак" — #14417, `13183233726`, ru, 5★
> *(translation: I tried all the main planners on the market; next to Tappsk they are just dire)*

> "combine tasks + habits in one place makes sense" — #7649, `8730080790`, us, 5★

> "Гораздо удобней стандартных заметок и напоминаний" — #5, `3304698631`, ru, 5★
> *(translation: much more convenient than the built-in Notes and Reminders)*

#97 is the most-voted review in the corpus (156 votes, 2019); the developer's own vc.ru article brought several early users (`MKT_PRESS` **13** reviews, **0.09%** of 15,176).

**Evidence:** `3301701050`, `5997304916`, `6676135932`, `7411252185`, `8220120605`, `9133320729`, `9898646652`, `10934108435`, `12166357406`, `14504520574`.

## 0.2 The 7-day trial that charged immediately is the largest single source of 1★ reviews

`MON_AUTO_CHARGE` **229** reviews, **1.51%** of 15,176 — Meaningful signal, mean 1.82★, 2019-06-02 → 2026-07-25. It carries 163 of the 674 1★ reviews (24.2%, segment rate) and co-occurs with `MON_TRIAL` in 111 reviews and with `MON_REFUND` in 113. The pattern is stable across five years: a reviewer taps "7 days free", a year's fee (999 ₽ in 73 of these reviews) is taken at once or on day six, the subscription is hard to find and cancel (`MON_CANCEL_TROUBLE` 73), and charges continue after deletion. It peaked in 2020 (2.9% of E2) and has never gone away (1.2% of E6).

> "при выборе бесплатной недели сразу списали деньги за год" — #2448, `6311375123`, ru, 1★
> *(translation: on choosing the free week they immediately took a year's money)*

> "«7 дней бесплатно», а сами втихую списываете на 6 день" — #1004, `5676768910`, ru, 2★
> *(translation: '7 days free', yet you quietly charge on day 6)*

> "списали деньги за приложение, которого у меня нет" — #4136, `6976074774`, ru, 5★
> *(translation: money was taken for an app I no longer have)*

> "Списывают деньги, даже если приложение удалено" — #15123, `14345786054`, ru, 1★
> *(translation: they take money even when the app is deleted)*

> "После отмены подписки приложение каждый раз пытается списать с карты средства" — #12562, `11390008426`, ru, 1★
> *(translation: after cancelling, the app keeps trying to charge the card)*


Some of these are the reviewer's own missed cancellation ("забыла отменить подписку" *(forgot to cancel the subscription)* (#2966, `6516703708`, ru, 5★)); the app still receives the 1★. Support sometimes refunds ("Все вернули! Оперативно" *(refunded everything, promptly)* (#222, `4861219077`, ru, 5★)) and sometimes does not ("Деньги, естественно, никто не возвращает" *(naturally nobody returns the money)* (#133, `4253774614`, ru, 1★)).

**Evidence:** `4253774614`, `5648423037`, `6064206204`, `6411826355`, `6705910204`, `7273681067`, `8002465664`, `9543755153`, `11728726587`, `14345786054`.

## 0.3 The January-2021 free-tier cut and the update that locked paying users out

`MON_FREE_CUT` **103** reviews, **0.68%** of 15,176 — Emerging signal, mean 2.21★, 2020-01-19 → 2025-10-10. 80 of the 103 fall in 2021-01→04: an update capped the free tier at 20 tasks (reviewers also report 10, 3 and "2 habits, 2 recurring"), removed free habits for some, and at the same time stopped recognising existing purchases — `BUG_PURCHASE` 45 reviews in 2021-01→03, 57 in E3 (1.7% of the era, its peak). Any price objection reaches its era maximum here (`U_PRICE_OBJECTION` 10.1% of E3) and E3 has the lowest era mean after the launch year (4.50★). The second most-voted review in the corpus (#4384, 94 votes) is this complaint.

> "с бесплатной версии убрали привычки, раньше можно было использовать две, а теперь НИ ОДНОЙ" — #541, `5424921597`, ua, 2★
> *(translation: habits were removed from the free version; before you could use two, now NONE)*

> "Разработчик ответил что их 50, но в приложении доступно лишь 20" — #4332, `7057459407`, ru, 5★
> *(translation: the developer replied that it is 50, but only 20 are available in the app)*

> "Вы просите 2500₽ при покупке навсегда" — #4384, `7074918019`, ru, 5★
> *(translation: you ask 2,500 ₽ for the lifetime purchase)*

> "Я уже покупала платную версию на всегда, почему она слетела??" — #3699, `6828890559`, ru, 1★
> *(translation: I already bought the paid version forever, why has it dropped off??)*

> "премиум у меня куплен ещё с июля" — #3698, `6828852918`, ru, 2★
> *(translation: I have had premium since July)*


The free-tier limit itself is the most frequent objection in every era: `MON_FREE_LIMIT` **697** reviews, **4.59%** of 15,176 — Very strong signal, mean 3.82★, 2019-01-10 → 2026-07-28. From 2021 onward the wording is "only 2 habits / 2 recurring tasks free" ("you only get two habits and two recurring events before you get blocked with a pay wall" (#13357, `11991927304`, ca, 3★)); before it was "20 tasks". Some accept it: "but that’s fair enough" (#13325, `11954179428`, dk, 5★).

**Evidence:** `5424921597`, `6845886967`, `6896799004`, `7021320461`, `7060798259`, `7074918019`, `7120936666`, `7269069571`, `8936743115`, `13250040158`.

## 0.4 From March 2022 Russian users could not pay through the App Store; a direct-card checkout later turns this into praise

`MON_PAYMENT_METHOD` **74** reviews, **0.49%** of 15,176 — Weak signal, mean 4.31★, 2020-03-03 → 2026-07-05. Only 6 reviews mention a payment route before 2022-03; 26 arrive in the rest of 2022, when reviewers say Apple Pay and Russian cards stopped working. 72 of 74 are on the Russian storefront. Unusually for a payment complaint, 54 of the 74 are 5★: reviewers want to pay and ask how ("не могу оплатить премиум - версию, с кем мне связаться" *(I cannot pay for premium — whom do I contact)* (#7224, `8518222803`, ru, 5★)). Support answered some within minutes ("в течении 10-20 минут решили" *(solved within 10–20 minutes)* (#7217, `8515045646`, ru, 5★)); from 2024 a direct bank-card route appears in praise ("спасибо, что можно оплачивать напрямую по банковской карте" *(thanks for letting us pay directly by bank card)* (#13882, `12480320347`, ru, 5★); "за возможность альтернативной оплаты подписки для РФ" *(for the alternative way to pay for the subscription in Russia)* (#14663, `13606147288`, kz, 5★)), and also in the complaints about charges after deletion (§0.2) because App Store subscription management no longer shows the app ("В Айфоне в подписках вас у меня нет" *(you are not in my iPhone subscriptions)* (#14552, `13382307021`, ru, 1★)).

> "Не мог оплатить подписку, так как эпл больше не принимает российские карты. Разработчики решили проблему" — #7138, `8482434347`, ru, 5★
> *(translation: could not pay because Apple no longer accepts Russian cards; the developers solved it)*

> "у меня мобильный оператор Megafon" — #11306, `10534966149`, ru, 5★
> *(translation: my mobile operator is Megafon)*

> "Нашла способ оплатить из России и купила" — #9338, `9567686482`, ru, 5★
> *(translation: I found a way to pay from Russia and bought it)*


**Evidence:** `5610817154`, `8515045646`, `8724203183`, `9039867577`, `9525631672`, `10131309786`, `10775299468`, `11302828146`, `12738318710`, `14265180049`.

## 0.5 The lifetime unlock is the monetization asset — and lifetime buyers are the ones asked to pay again

Buyers state a purchase in `MON_PAID` **1090** reviews, **7.18%** of 15,176 — High-priority signal, mean 4.31★, 2019-01-15 → 2026-09-03; 396 of them name the lifetime unlock (`MON_LIFETIME` **430** reviews, **2.83%** of 15,176). Value judgements are positive: `MON_VALUE` **465** reviews, **3.06%** of 15,176 (mean 4.93★), and the one-time option itself is praised 93 times against only 23 objections to subscription pricing — the reverse of most habit apps. Discounts do the selling: `MON_DISCOUNT` **224** reviews, **1.48%** of 15,176, with lifetime named at 449–600 ₽ on sale against 1,490–2,500 ₽ list (§9.G).

The cost of that model: lifetime buyers report the unlock disappearing or a second charge. `BUG_PURCHASE` 45 and `MON_PAID_TWICE` 28 of the 430 lifetime reviews; 57 lifetime reviews are 1–2★. The 2021-01 update (§0.3) is the largest cluster; the rest are spread to 2026: a year after buying "forever", the app asks again.

> "спасибо разработчикам за отсутсвие подписки" — #196, `4710971288`, ru, 5★
> *(translation: thanks to the developers for not having a subscription)*

> "5€ de por vida que es lo que te cobran las demás al mes" — #8438, `9146548136`, es, 5★
> *(translation: €5 for life, which is what the others charge per month)*

> "мной было оплачено пожизненное использование, но приложение висит в подписках с припиской «на год»" — #261, `5095024136`, ru, 5★
> *(translation: I paid for lifetime use, but the app sits in subscriptions marked 'for a year')*

> "купил полную версию на всегда за 1500 тыс, сегодня списалось 999 рублей за подписку" — #5035, `7466929882`, ru, 5★
> *(translation: bought the full version forever for 1,500; today 999 roubles were taken for a subscription)*

> "Покупала версию «Навсегда», спустя год написали, что пора опять оплатить «навсегда» ещё раз" — #13758, `12353908918`, ru, 1★
> *(translation: I bought 'Forever'; a year later they wrote that it was time to pay 'forever' again)*

> "Kurz nach dem Kauf wurde der Preis durch einen Zufallsgenerator reduziert" — #11765, `10839438623`, de, 4★
> *(translation: shortly after the purchase the price was reduced by a random generator)*


**Evidence:** `4238407684`, `5920658568`, `6485049126`, `6974939853`, `7910145492`, `8731434537`, `10114139002`, `11267081983`, `12572090210`, `14472989926`.

## 0.6 Four dated regressions: Oct-2021 crash on old iOS, then in 2023 the recurring-task crash, the calendar opening a year back, and freezes

`BUG_CRASH` **215** reviews, **1.42%** of 15,176 — Meaningful signal, mean 2.81★, 2019-02-28 → 2026-07-24; `BUG_UPDATE` **103** reviews, **0.68%** of 15,176 — Emerging signal, mean 2.83★, 2019-02-28 → 2026-07-13. The complaints are not spread evenly; they cluster within days of releases:

- **2021-10-22 → 25**: 36 crash reports in 2021-10, 33 of them in four days. Reviewers on iPhone 6/6+/7 and iOS 12–14 cannot open the app after an iOS-15-era update ("на версии ПО 12.5.5, IPhone 6+, перестало заходить в приложение" *(on 12.5.5, iPhone 6+, the app no longer opens)* (#5952, `7941135777`, ru, 1★); "у меня всё перестало работать на шестом айфоне" *(everything stopped working on my iPhone 6)* (#5951, `7941117734`, ru, 4★)).
- **2023-06 → 10**: completing a recurring task closes the app (`BUG_RECURRING` **37** reviews, **0.24%** of 15,176, 14 in these months). One reviewer isolates the trigger — the "show completed tasks" setting — and notes support advised hiding them ("дело в отображении выполненных задач" *(it is the display of completed tasks)* (#10868, `10335459972`, ru, 5★); "За три месяца никаких подвижек с этим багом" *(no progress on this bug in three months)* (#10904, `10351281175`, ru, 2★)). A reviewer names the build: "Tappsk 2.5.397 Build 397 iOS 16.5" (#10513, `10148052052`, ru, 4★).
- **2023-08 → 12**: the calendar opens on the same month of 2022 (`BUG_CALENDAR` **51** reviews, **0.34%** of 15,176, 23 in these months): "нужно календарь две минуты листать с апреля 2022" *(you have to scroll the calendar for two minutes from April 2022)* (#10974, `10383577572`, ru, 2★). Fixed by December: "P.S. Все исправлено, спасибо" *(P.S. all fixed, thanks)* (#11499, `10652121920`, ru, 5★).
- **2023-10**: the app freezes after one action (`BUG_PERF` **36** reviews, **0.24%** of 15,176, 10 in 2023-10): "можно ставить только одну галочку, потом не реагирует" *(you can tick only one box, then it stops responding)* (#11274, `10525597408`, ru, 3★).

E5 (2023-06 → 2024-04) therefore carries the highest crash rate of any era after launch (2.6%). Later, smaller clusters: widgets going blank or stale after updates (`BUG_WIDGET` 100; "при переключении дня задачи на виджете не меняются" *(when the day changes the tasks on the widget do not change)* (#14740, `13688781045`, ru, 4★)) and crashes on launch in 2026-05 (7 reviews). The developer's 2026-08 release notes (external, §2.2) list exactly these areas: iCloud sync, duplicate recurring tasks, the Watch app and widgets.

**Evidence:** `3825379548`, `6389491813`, `7055953001`, `7944463011`, `8479321365`, `10004087209`, `10311017030`, `10915200942`, `12380569127`, `14341897960`.

## 0.7 Unmet needs: a computer (Windows or web), a time on the task, and marking yesterday done

Requests touch `U_REQ_ANY` **2258** reviews, **14.88%** of 15,176. The three that persist:

1. **A desktop.** `U_PLATFORM_REQ` **385** reviews, **2.54%** of 15,176 — `REQ_DESKTOP` **208** reviews, **1.37%** of 15,176, `REQ_WEB` **104** reviews, **0.69%** of 15,176, `REQ_ANDROID` **28** reviews, **0.18%** of 15,176. The Mac app shipped in 2020-06 and was sold separately (`MON_PER_DEVICE` 59: "Она платная для тех кто уже премиум?" *(is it paid for those who already have premium?)* (#1964, `6079771386`, ru, 5★)); the request then shifts to Windows and the browser ("Сделайте версию для ПК на WINDOWS 10" *(make a version for PC on Windows 10)* (#1994, `6104445084`, ru, 5★); "нужна веб версия, товарищи" *(we need a web version, comrades)* (#14886, `13904252067`, ru, 5★)), and to the Mac app being left behind ("Там какое то старое приложение,которое давно не обновляется" *(there is some old app there that has not been updated in ages)* (#12454, `11286087766`, ru, 2★); "garder à jour la version Mac qui semble délaissé" *(keep the Mac version up to date, it seems abandoned)* (#14060, `12663645398`, fr, 4★)). Desktop requests fall from 6.0% of E1 to 0.6% of E4 and hold near 1% since.
2. **A time, and an order, on the task.** `U_SCHEDULE_REQ` **471** reviews, **3.10%** of 15,176 — `REQ_TIME` **186** reviews, **1.23%** of 15,176, `REQ_SORT` **132** reviews, **0.87%** of 15,176, `REQ_CALENDAR_VIEW` **118** reviews, **0.78%** of 15,176, `REQ_ADVANCE_REMINDER` **68** reviews, **0.45%** of 15,176. A task has a reminder time but no event time, so lists do not order themselves by the day's timeline ("чтобы задача на 09:00 стояла выше задачи на 11:00" *(so that the 09:00 task sits above the 11:00 task)* (#14417, `13183233726`, ru, 5★); "тк нет в приложении времени - я просто в названиях пишу время" *(since the app has no time, I just write the time in the titles)* (#15021, `14087812180`, us, 5★)). `REQ_TIME` is at its era maximum in E6 (1.8%).
3. **Yesterday.** `U_HISTORY_REQ` **253** reviews, **1.67%** of 15,176 — `REQ_BACKFILL` **62** reviews, **0.41%** of 15,176, `REQ_SHOW_DONE` **71** reviews, **0.47%** of 15,176, `REQ_STATS` **114** reviews, **0.75%** of 15,176, `NEG_HISTORY` **18** reviews, **0.12%** of 15,176, plus the midnight boundary (`NEG_DAY_BOUNDARY` 19). Unfinished tasks roll to today and cannot be marked done for the day they were done ("если я выполнила задачу в 00:01 и хочу отметить её выполненной за предыдущую дату" *(if I did the task at 00:01 and want to mark it done for the previous date)* (#14305, `13036787092`, ru, 4★); "Как быть совам" *(what about night owls)* (#285, `5226238815`, ru, 1★)); habits show a week, not a month ("Не нашел полноценную сводную статистику по всем привычкам" *(could not find a proper summary statistic across all habits)* (#14345, `13080691665`, ru, 3★)).

Attachments are the next tier: `U_ATTACH_REQ` **223** reviews, **1.47%** of 15,176 ("ГДЕ ПРИКРЕПИТЬ ФОТО" *(WHERE DO I ATTACH A PHOTO)* (#62, `3882857828`, ru, 4★)). Several reviewers say the app has not changed in years: `NEG_DEV_PROMISE` **88** reviews, **0.58%** of 15,176, rising to 1.1% of E6 ("there were added zero new features" (#14861, `13879749140`, ua, 3★); "Два года прошу добавить эту простую фичу" *(I have been asking for this simple feature for two years)* (#11975, `10958883560`, ru, 1★)).

**Evidence:** `3334609644`, `5624959804`, `6227238989`, `6744353449`, `7627449945`, `8595218323`, `9699053533`, `10908865904`, `12292931608`, `14451954398`.

## 0.8 The "let the developers be sad" prompt is named in 2% of reviews from 2020 on, and a few reviewers resent it; bursts are disclosed, not dropped

`REV_SOLICITED` **309** reviews, **2.04%** of 15,176 — Meaningful signal, mean 4.77★, 2020-01-01 → 2026-07-19. None before 2020-01; 6 in 2020-01 alone, then 1.6–2.5% of every era. Reviewers quote the dismiss button — "пусть разработчики грустят" (let the developers be sad) — as the reason they wrote ("Отдельный респект разработчикам за окно с отзывами" *(special respect to the developers for the review window)* (#13869, `12468108128`, ru, 5★); "adorei a estratégia para deixarmos a avaliação" *(loved the strategy for getting us to leave a review)* (#2878, `6484666207`, br, 5★)). 12 of the 309 are 1–2★ reviews about the prompt itself ("это манипуляция эмоциями" *(this is emotional manipulation)* (#3464, `6709846085`, ua, 1★); "Хватит меня каждую секунду просить оставить отзыв" *(stop asking me every second to leave a review)* (#628, `5470893305`, by, 1★); "Saudumme Formulierung" *(idiotic wording)* (#14835, `13827246849`, de, 1★)), and it is named in the distrust of other reviews (`REV_DISTRUST` 32: "начитались купленных отзывов" *(having read the bought reviews)* (#14774, `13740181043`, ru, 1★)).

14 days carry 20+ reviews (324 reviews, 2.13%), 77.5% of them 5★. Two are not praise bursts: 2021-01-04 (28 reviews, 13 of them purchase failures) and 2021-03-03 (22 reviews, 10 of them the free-tier cut). One is an artefact: on 2020-04-05, 19 Korean-storefront 5★ reviews describe an RPG game, not this app (`WRONG_APP` 20; "뻔한 RPG게임이지만 그래도 뻔해서 좋네" *(a predictable RPG, but good because it is predictable)* (#1162, `5765513375`, kr, 5★)). They are kept, coded `WRONG_APP` only, and disclosed (§9.H).

**Evidence:** `5347259262`, `6484666207`, `7117266715`, `8050815628`, `8748522320`, `9564840255`, `10336469896`, `11232478136`, `12468108128`, `14321673961`.

# PART 1 — SCOPE AND METHOD

## 1.1 Files used

| File | Role | Records |
|---|---|---:|
| `App Store Reviews/59. Tappsk - ToDo & Habit Tracker - Task Manager & Daily schedule/reviews.jsonl` | **the corpus**; every claim resolves here | 15,176 |
| `by_country/*.jsonl` | 109 per-storefront files | 15,176 (union) |
| `manifest.json` | extraction metadata, per-country counts, rating distribution | — |
| `_state.json` | collection state per polled storefront | — |
| Apple iTunes Lookup API (external, 2026-09-14) | public rating, listing text, version, languages | 19 storefronts |

## 1.2 Schema actually present

All 13 fields are present on all 15,176 records; no title or body is empty.

| Field | Used for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | primary key | 15,176 distinct; zero duplicates |
| `country`, `country_name` | §6 | 109 storefronts |
| `rating` | §4 | integers 1–5 only |
| `title`, `body` | **read in full for every record** | median body length 72 characters |
| `author` | authenticity tests only (§9.H) | 28 names appear on more than one storefront |
| `date` | §7 | 2018-10-14 → 2026-09-05 |
| `vote_count`, `vote_sum` | §9.H | 371 reviews have votes; max 156 |
| `is_edited` | §9.H | 996 edited |
| `app_id`, `app_name` | constant (`1385049326`, `Tappsk: ToDo & Habit Tracker`) | |

**Not present, and therefore never claimed:** app version per review, purchase or subscription records, developer responses, device, and any identifier linking a reviewer to a purchase.

**Reviews read: 15,176/15,176 = 100%. Reviews hand-coded: 15,176/15,176 = 100%.** No deduplication was applied: there are no technical duplicates. Identical short bodies under different authors are kept and disclosed (§9.H).

## 1.4 Processing method

1. `59-dump.py` emits all 15,176 reviews in date order with a stable index (1…15,176).
2. Reviews were read in date order in batches of 100 (152 classification files, the last holding 76), in full, in the original language. Translations quoted here were checked against the source string.
3. Each review received hand codes plus a note quoting the text that drove them (`59-cls/*.txt`, 15,176 lines).
4. **After every batch**, `59-check-cls.py` re-asserted each line's `review_id` at its index and that every quoted fragment in the note occurs in that review. Lines were written without IDs and `59-fill-ids.py` filled them from the index, so an ID cannot drift from its text (§9.C).
5. `59-build-classification.py` rejects unknown codes, adds mechanical codes (`STAR_n`, `ERA_En`) and derives 20 unions.
6. `59-validate.py` runs the data checks in §9.C.
7. `59-build-report.py` computes every number and chooses every representative ID from the data at build time. It **refuses to write** if any quotation is not found verbatim in the review it is attributed to, and asserts every trend direction stated in the narrative.
8. `59-verify-report.py` re-reads the written file and checks it against the corpus (§9.M).

**Classification is hand judgement, not an algorithm.** No clustering, keyword rule or model assigned a code.

## 1.5 Signal thresholds

| Share of reviews | Label |
|---|---|
| < 0.1% | Ignore by default |
| 0.1% – < 0.5% | Weak signal |
| 0.5% – < 1% | Emerging signal |
| 1% – < 3% | Meaningful signal |
| 3% – 5% | Very strong signal |
| > 5% | High-priority signal |

At n=15,176, 0.1% ≈ 15 reviews, 1% ≈ 152 and 5% ≈ 759. Segment rates (within a star band, era, storefront or the paid segment) are labelled as segment rates and show both denominators.

## 1.6 Limitations, stated plainly

- **Selection.** Satisfied users are prompted to rate (§0.8); dissatisfied users write when something breaks or a card is charged. Neither measures typical use.
- **One storefront dominates.** 70.29% of reviews are on the Russian storefront and 76.09% are in Russian. Global bands are Russian-speaking bands; §6 shows where other storefronts differ.
- **Purchases are unverifiable.** Prices, charges, refunds and restore failures are the reviewer's account.
- **No version data.** Product changes are dated from reviewer statements and clusters, and from the listing's current version and release notes.
- **Thin late corpus.** Monthly volume falls from a 2021-01 peak of 372 to under 100 through 2026; E6 findings rest on fewer reviews per month.
- **Language mix.** 11,548 reviews are in Russian and 1,457 in English; 22 other languages carry 2,061, and 110 are emoji or symbols only.

# PART 2 — PRODUCT AND MONETIZATION MODEL

## 2.1 What the product is, from the reviews

A daily to-do list with a habit tracker on the same screen. Tasks sit in four buckets (today, tomorrow, this week, later); unfinished tasks roll forward to the next day automatically; a task can carry a colour category, a reminder, subtasks and a note, and can be recurring. Habits appear as a row of icons at the top and are ticked daily; a productivity score summarises the day. There are hidden lists (books, films, shopping), a calendar view of a chosen day with Apple Calendar events, voice entry by holding the add button, a task diary (logbook), home-screen widgets, an Apple Watch app and a Mac app that syncs through iCloud. The free tier caps habits, recurring tasks and reminders; Premium removes the caps and is sold monthly, annually or as a lifetime unlock.

## 2.4 What could not be established

- The exact free-tier caps at any date; reviewers name 2, 3, 5, 10, 20 and 50 in different months.
- Whether the immediate trial charges are an App Store behaviour, a bug, or a design; and whether refunds were granted.
- The mechanism of the direct-card billing and how cancellation works outside the App Store.
- Current prices by region; the same lifetime unlock is named at 449 ₽ and 2,500 ₽ within a year.

**Why it works, in reviewers' words:**

- **Entry costs seconds.** "позволяет тебе записать задачу быстрее чем ты ее забудешь" *(lets you write the task down faster than you forget it)* (#14461, `13255885715`, ru, 5★); "Задачи добавляются за пол секунды" *(tasks are added in half a second)* (#13114, `11803065014`, kz, 5★) — including by voice (`PR_VOICE` **52** reviews, **0.34%** of 15,176).
- **Nothing extra.** `PR_SIMPLE` **1704** reviews, **11.23%** of 15,176: "Ничего лишнего. Удобно" *(nothing superfluous. Convenient)* (#7373, `8590926525`, ru, 5★); "отсутствуют ненужные мешающие опции, присущие аналогам" *(the unneeded, obstructive options of the rivals are absent)* (#12094, `11022679672`, ru, 5★). Asking the developer not to change it: `PR_KEEP_SIMPLE` **49** reviews, **0.32%** of 15,176.
- **Carry-over without guilt.** `PR_AUTO_CARRY` **69** reviews, **0.45%** of 15,176: "all your unfinished today’s tasks move to tomorrow" (#11391, `10582924323`, us, 5★); the same mechanism is a complaint for others (`NEG_RECURRING_CARRY` 28, §3.5).
- **Colour categories and the one screen.** `PR_SECTIONS` **134** reviews, **0.88%** of 15,176, `PR_ONE_SCREEN` **82** reviews, **0.54%** of 15,176: "Die Ansicht „heutige und zukünftige Aufgaben“ ist bei keiner Anderen App so gut und Übersichtlich aufgeteilt" *(the today-and-upcoming view is not laid out this well in any other app)* (#11765, `10839438623`, de, 4★).
- **The developer.** `PR_DEV` **1244** reviews, **8.20%** of 15,176; reviewers thank them by name and note the Russian origin (`PR_RU_DEV` **10** reviews, **0.07%** of 15,176): "это еще и русский создатель а не зарубежный" *(and it is a Russian creator, not a foreign one)* (#14832, `13820151786`, ru, 5★).

Two further points: the upsell itself is a complaint — `MON_UPSELL` 97 ("Каждый день по 30 раз пихают мне всплывающее окошко «Купите нашу полную версию»" *(thirty times a day they push the pop-up: buy our full version)* (#11750, `10830000286`, ru, 2★)) — and disclosure is the objection behind many 1★ reviews (`MON_DISCLOSURE` **80** reviews, **0.53%** of 15,176, `MON_PAYWALL_SURPRISE` **64** reviews, **0.42%** of 15,176: "Пишите сразу, что ПО платное, а не встроенные покупки" *(say up front that the software is paid, not in-app purchases)* (#3639, `6782314326`, ru, 1★)).

- **Regressions** are §0.6. **Purchase not recognised**: `BUG_PURCHASE` **142** reviews, **0.94%** of 15,176 — Emerging signal, mean 2.81★, 2019-11-06 → 2026-07-24, e.g. "оплачено 990руб за подписку , но работать в этой программе нельзя пока ещё 1499 руб не заплатите" *(990 ₽ paid for the subscription, but you cannot work in the program until you pay another 1,499 ₽)* (#6387, `8119749092`, ru, 1★).
- **Reminders that do not fire** persist in every era: `BUG_REMINDER` 96 ("unless you open the app every other day, the reminders you set will stop working" (#12919, `11682385361`, gb, 1★); "за весь день дай бог словить хотя бы 2 уведомления" *(in a whole day you are lucky to catch two notifications)* (#14637, `13564198701`, ru, 1★)). Turkish reviewers report a crash when setting a habit reminder ("app closes when i try to set" (#12091, `11020375846`, tr, 4★); §6).
- **Data loss and sync**: `U_DATA_RISK` 104 — "но все мои задачи пропали" *(but all my tasks disappeared)* (#15047, `14114704622`, ru, 2★); "На iphone не работает синхронизация" *(sync does not work on the iPhone)* (#11816, `10865716992`, ru, 1★); "Нигде не указано, что задачу надо обязательно сохранить" *(nowhere does it say that a task must be saved)* (#12375, `11215422615`, ru, 3★).

- **Confusing on first use.** `NEG_UI_CONFUSING` 152 and `NEG_ONBOARDING` 78: reviewers cannot find how to delete a habit, set a reminder on a habit, or see what the productivity score means ("не могу понять как удалить ненужную привычку" *(cannot work out how to delete an unwanted habit)* (#13331, `11964877237`, ru, 5★); "не очень понятно что значит 115" *(not clear what 115 means)* (#14675, `13622497679`, us, 5★)).
- **Carry-over and the day boundary.** `NEG_RECURRING_CARRY` 28, `NEG_PLAN_AHEAD` 32, `NEG_DAY_BOUNDARY` 19: recurring tasks do not show on future dates ("Открывая календарь задача во вт не отображается" *(opening the calendar, the Tuesday task is not shown)* (#14448, `13245077158`, ru, 4★)) and a missed item cannot be marked as missed ("чтобы можно было задачу пометить как НЕ сделанную" *(so that a task can be marked as NOT done)* (#13459, `12086132243`, ru, 5★)).
- **The score demotivates some.** `NEG_SCORE` 23: "ОЧЕНЬ ДЕМОТИВИРУЕТ эта стрелочка которая показывает насколько я продуктивна" *(this arrow showing how productive I am is VERY demotivating)* (#11973, `10957454552`, ru, 4★).
- **Too plain for some.** `NEG_DESIGN` 49, `NEG_LIMITED` 115: "приложение вообще не меняется годами" *(the app has not changed at all in years)* (#14323, `13057793501`, ru, 5★).

Reviewers switching *to* Tappsk (`COMP_SWITCHED_FROM` **110** reviews, **0.72%** of 15,176) outnumber those leaving for another app (`CHURN_SWITCHED` **43** reviews, **0.28%** of 15,176). They come from Notes and Reminders ("Гораздо удобней стандартных заметок и напоминаний" *(much more convenient than the built-in Notes and Reminders)* (#5, `3304698631`, ru, 5★)), paper, Todoist, Trello and Notion — the last two after those services left Russia ("После того как Trello стало невозможно пользоваться на территории России" *(after Trello became unusable in Russia)* (#11987, `10966052624`, ru, 5★); "выбрал Tappsk после ухода Notion" *(chose Tappsk after Notion left)* (#13027, `11752235590`, ru, 5★)) — and from Things ("Desinstalei o Things por causa desse app" *(I uninstalled Things because of this app)* (#13893, `12493280516`, br, 5★)). Those who leave name TickTick and Things and the reasons in §0.6–§0.7 ("по итогу я пользуюсь TickTick" *(in the end I use TickTick)* (#14975, `14007929696`, ru, 4★); "пришлось отказаться в пользу things из-за отсутствия поддержки Mac" *(had to give it up for Things because of the missing Mac support)* (#12454, `11286087766`, ru, 2★)). Returning users are frequent relative to leavers: `CHURN_RETURN` 36 ("Сто раз скачивала, сто раз удаляла, но в итоге всегда возвращаюсь" *(downloaded it a hundred times, deleted it a hundred times, but I always come back)* (#12761, `11556849371`, ru, 5★)).

Acquisition is word of mouth and Russian-language media: `MKT_WOM` 41, `MKT_BLOGGER` 19 ("посмотрел видео у Маргулана" *(watched a video by Margulan)* (#8239, `9057417749`, ru, 5★); "я смотрела тик ток" *(I was watching TikTok)* (#10566, `10176992080`, ru, 5★)), `MKT_PRESS` 13 ("Статья на vc- топ!" *(the article on vc — top!)* (#559, `5433538754`, ru, 5★)).

Both kinds of report are more frequent in E5–E6 than in 2020–2023. Praise names fast e-mail and Telegram replies and refunds ("Поддержка решила вопрос очень быстро" *(support solved it very quickly)* (#12254, `11127123256`, ru, 5★); "j’ai réussi à joindre le support par Télégram qui a été d’une grande aide" *(I managed to reach support on Telegram, which was a great help)* (#14068, `12675143558`, fr, 5★); "поддержка подарила мне подписку навсегда другой аккаунт" *(support gifted me the lifetime subscription on another account)* (#14543, `13366922113`, ru, 5★)). Silence is reported for e-mail, mostly on billing and sync ("пишу на почту уже 2 раза, ответа нет" *(I have e-mailed twice, no reply)* (#15042, `14107533962`, ru, 1★); "На почту пишешь не отвечают, в тг пишешь бот" *(e-mail goes unanswered; on Telegram you get a bot)* (#13807, `12401679164`, ru, 2★)). Several reviewers say a bug they reported was acknowledged but never fixed ("каждый раз обещают направить разработчикам, но проблема остается" *(each time they promise to pass it to the developers, but the problem remains)* (#14740, `13688781045`, ru, 4★)).

## 4.3 Rating-versus-text contradictions

`CONTRA_RATING` **155** reviews, **1.02%** of 15,176. 102 are 4–5★ reviews whose text reports a problem (most frequent codes among them: `BUG_CRASH` 29, `MON_AUTO_CHARGE` 24, `MON_REFUND` 21, `BUG_UPDATE` 14): "Возможно ли вернуть деньги после списания" *(is it possible to get the money back after the charge)* (#2966, `6516703708`, ru, 5★); "при открытии выкидывает и не заходит" *(on opening it throws me out and will not load)* (#15027, `14096098531`, ru, 4★). 20 are 1–2★ reviews whose text is praise or a request: "Все удобно и интуитивно понятно, мне очень комфортно пользоваться! Рекомендую" *(everything is convenient and intuitive, I am very comfortable using it! Recommend)* (#14028, `12623571929`, ru, 1★). The rest are 3★ pure praise. All are kept and coded by their text.

# PART 5 — PAID-USER AND UPGRADE ANALYSIS

## 5.1 The populations, and what they are not

- **Stated purchase: `MON_PAID` 1090 (7.18% of 15,176)**, mean 4.31★, 2019-01-15 → 2026-09-03. Of these, `MON_LIFETIME` 396 name the lifetime unlock.
- **Stated purchase, charge, refund or unlock problem: `U_PAID` 1408 (9.28%)**, mean 3.85★.
- **On the trial: `MON_TRIAL` 306 (2.02%)**, mean 3.14★ — low because 111 of them report an immediate charge; 51 state intent to buy.
- **Intent to buy: `MON_INTENT` 381 (2.51%)**, mean 4.70★. **Worth it, without saying they bought: `MON_VALUE` not in `MON_PAID`** 286.
- **Upgrade barrier: `U_PRICE_OBJECTION` 1169 (7.70%)**, mean 3.56★.

**None of these is a conversion rate.** The corpus cannot say how many users pay, renew or are refunded.

## 5.2 What triggers a purchase

Within the 1090 reviews stating a purchase (segment rates):

1. **The lifetime offer, usually on sale.** `MON_LIFETIME` 396 (36.3%), `MON_DISCOUNT` 129 (11.8%): "дождался скидку и купил премиум навсегда" *(waited for the discount and bought premium forever)* (#5850, `7900587923`, ru, 4★); "выскочило предложение взять премиум навсегда с хорошей скидкой, не задумываясь взял" *(an offer popped up to take premium forever at a good discount; I took it without thinking)* (#12055, `11004111636`, ru, 5★).
2. **The app worked in the first days.** `JUST_STARTED` 40 purchasers bought within days: "Поюзал один день и купил навсегда" *(used it one day and bought forever)* (#13098, `11791791548`, ua, 5★); "Оформила премиум в тот же день, когда скачала" *(took premium the same day I downloaded it)* (#12804, `11585930293`, ru, 5★).
3. **Hitting the habit cap.** `MON_FREE_LIMIT` 13: "I just wanted to unlock more Habits" (#13482, `12110291519`, us, 5★); "чисто из-за большего числа привычек" *(purely for more habits)* (#14700, `13644589198`, ru, 5★).
4. **Better than the rest.** `PR_BETTER_THAN` 179 (16.4%): "Сразу купила программу навсегда" *(bought the program forever straight away)* (#4705, `7229643172`, ru, 5★).
5. **Supporting the developer.** `MON_DONATE_WISH` 18: "Купил навсегда чтобы поддержать разработчиков" *(bought forever to support the developers)* (#13942, `12529102869`, ru, 5★); "приобрела подписку, чтобы отблагодарить разработчиков" *(bought the subscription to thank the developers)* (#14828, `13811965764`, ru, 5★).

892 of 1090 purchasers (81.8%) rate 4–5★; 147 (13.5%) rate 1–2★. Satisfied buyers name value, the one-time price and permanence; dissatisfied buyers name a purchase that did not unlock, was charged twice, or was cancelled by the app.

| Code | Dir | Meaning | n | % of 15,176 | Band | Mean ★ | Dates |
|---|:-:|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---|
| `MON_PAID` | ~ | States a purchase | 1090 | 7.18% | High-priority signal | 4.31 | 2019-01-15 → 2026-09-03 |
| `MON_LIFETIME` | ~ | Bought lifetime | 430 | 2.83% | Meaningful signal | 4.35 | 2019-05-31 → 2026-08-26 |

| `BUG_PURCHASE` | - | Purchase not applied | 142 | 0.94% | Emerging signal | 2.81 | 2019-11-06 → 2026-07-24 |
| `MON_PAID_TWICE` | - | Charged twice | 47 | 0.31% | Weak signal | 2.85 | 2019-09-29 → 2025-05-19 |

| `MON_PER_DEVICE` | - | Must buy per device / platform | 59 | 0.39% | Weak signal | 4.02 | 2020-03-14 → 2025-10-21 |

- **Paid, told to pay again**: "не могу добавить более 20-ти задач, говорит, надо оплатить премиум" *(cannot add more than 20 tasks; it says I must pay for premium)* (#3706, `6829914500`, ru, 3★); "Купила навсегда, а получается не навсегда" *(I bought forever, and it turns out not forever)* (#14372, `13130899515`, ru, 4★).
- **Paid twice**: "Плата за подписку навсегда списалась 2 раза" *(the lifetime fee was charged twice)* (#1977, `6087358548`, ru, 1★); "написано, что поддерживается семейный доступ" *(it says Family Sharing is supported)* (#1937, `6070071932`, ru, 1★).
- **Paid, then lost the account or the data**: "все записи удалились и больше не могу авторизоваться" *(all records were deleted and I can no longer sign in)* (#14466, `13260201732`, ru, 2★).
- **Paid, expected more**: "поторопился и оплатил подписку" *(I rushed and paid for the subscription)* (#14345, `13080691665`, ru, 3★); "Unfortunately I bought premium" (#13504, `12138681695`, ua, 2★).
- **Paid, and pleased**: "уже давно оплатила подписку «навсегда», не жалею" *(paid for the lifetime subscription long ago, no regrets)* (#15005, `14060488713`, ru, 5★).

- **Cannot pay from Russia** (§0.4): "Вы теряете живые деньги" *(you are losing real money)* (#14746, `13696767009`, ru, 5★).
- **Discount timing and disappearing offers**: "Предложение куда-то исчезло и желание купить пропало" *(the offer vanished somewhere and so did the wish to buy)* (#7096, `8459345520`, ru, 2★); "нажимаю на купит, а кнопка не активная" *(I press buy and the button is inactive)* (#14502, `13303118771`, ru, 3★).

## 5.6 Refund and churn drivers after purchase

`MON_REFUND` **159** reviews, **1.05%** of 15,176 — Meaningful signal, mean 1.94★, 2019-06-02 → 2026-03-03. The drivers are an immediate or post-cancellation charge (`MON_AUTO_CHARGE`, `MON_CANCEL_TROUBLE`), a second charge on a lifetime buyer (`MON_PAID_TWICE`), and a purchase that did not unlock (`BUG_PURCHASE`). Among purchasers, `U_CHURN` is 27 (2.5%) and `SUP_NONE` 28. Support refunds are reported both granted ("Все вернули! Оперативно" *(refunded everything, promptly)* (#222, `4861219077`, ru, 5★)) and refused ("техподдержка не видит причины возврата" *(support sees no reason for a refund)* (#2075, `6145445742`, ru, 1★); "I was rejected to refund of 20$ annual subscription" (#13267, `11915504481`, ua, 1★)).

## 5.7 What cannot be claimed here

- The share of users who buy, the split between lifetime and subscription, or renewal rates.
- Whether the immediate trial charges are systematic or a minority of trials; only the complaints are visible.
- Whether regional prices differ as reviewers report, or what the direct-card checkout charges.
- How many refunds were granted.

## 6.22 High-spend and high-review-volume markets

**No consumer-spend dataset was fetched in this session**, so no spend ranking is asserted. Two groups are defined from captured sources:

- **High-spend proxy group** = the six eligible storefronts with the most public ratings in Apple's lookup API (an install-base proxy, not spend): ru (32,119), ua (3,508), br (2,400), de (1,098), us (1,041), fr (932).
- **High-review-volume group** = storefronts with ≥200 reviews in this corpus: ru, ua, br, de, us, fr, kz, sa.

| Group | Reviews | Mean ★ | Praise % | Outcome % | Price objection % | Billing % | Payment access % | Bug % | Platform request % | Schedule request % | E6 share % |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| High-spend proxy: ru + ua + br + de + us + fr | 12,996 | 4.61 | 76.7% | 8.9% | 7.4% | 3.5% | 0.8% | 6.0% | 2.6% | 3.3% | 18.3% |
| High-volume: ru + ua + br + de + us + fr + kz + sa | 13,463 | 4.61 | 76.8% | 9.0% | 7.4% | 3.4% | 0.8% | 5.9% | 2.6% | 3.3% | 18.3% |
| ru + ua + kz + by (Russian-speaking storefronts) | 11,819 | 4.62 | 76.6% | 7.7% | 7.2% | 3.7% | 0.9% | 6.3% | 2.8% | 3.4% | 17.8% |
| us + gb + ca + au + in (English-speaking, eligible) | 725 | 4.51 | 76.1% | 20.3% | 9.1% | 1.0% | 0.0% | 6.8% | 1.8% | 2.1% | 19.6% |

**Reading:** billing and payment-access problems are a Russian-speaking-storefront phenomenon (App Store payments and the trial charge in roubles); the English-speaking group reports them at a fraction of that rate. Saudi Arabia and Turkey together sit above the global rate on price objections and defects (the Turkish habit-reminder crash). Brazil and Mexico, like the English-speaking group, describe outcomes at about twice the global rate; Brazil and Mexico also report billing and defects at a fraction of the global rate. Schedule and platform requests are spread evenly; no market is uniquely asking for a desktop.

One small storefront needs a note: 19 of the 42 Korean-storefront reviews describe a different app (an RPG game) and are coded `WRONG_APP` (§0.8, §9.H); Korea's remaining reviews follow the global praise profile, with two reports of the habit-reminder crash also seen in Turkey. No other small storefront shows a material, well-supported pattern of its own.

# PART 7 — TIME-TREND ANALYSIS

## 7.1 Method

Eras are cut at dated product or market changes that reviewers describe, checked against monthly volume and code clusters. §9.C asserts that the dated clusters stay in their eras.

- **E1 → E2 at 2020-01-01**: the first month with 100 or more reviews (310 in 2020-01 against 37 in 2019-12); the rating prompt appears the same month (`REV_SOLICITED` first 2020-01-01).
- **E2 → E3 at 2021-01-01**: the update that cut the free tier to 20 tasks and stopped recognising purchases (`MON_FREE_CUT`, `BUG_PURCHASE` clusters from 2021-01-04).
- **E3 → E4 at 2022-03-01**: App Store payment becomes unavailable to Russian users; `MON_PAYMENT_METHOD` reports begin 2022-03.
- **E4 → E5 at 2023-06-01**: the recurring-task crash (`BUG_RECURRING` cluster from 2023-06-07, build 2.5.397 named), followed by the calendar-year and freeze clusters.
- **E5 → E6 at 2024-05-01**: the E5 regression clusters have ended (last `BUG_CALENDAR` of the cluster 2023-12-03) and 2024-05 is the first month since 2019 with fewer than 130 reviews (126); the direct-card checkout appears in praise from 2024.

| Era | Name | Dates | Reviews | Per month | Mean ★ | 1–2★ % | 5★ % |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| E1 | Launch year | 2018-10-14 → 2019-12-31 | 319 | 21 | 4.25 | 11.0% | 64.9% |
| E2 | Growth wave and immediate trial charges | 2020-01-01 → 2020-12-31 | 3,356 | 280 | 4.62 | 5.8% | 80.7% |
| E3 | Free-tier cut and the Oct-2021 crash | 2021-01-01 → 2022-02-28 | 3,341 | 239 | 4.50 | 8.4% | 77.0% |
| E4 | Sanctions and payment workarounds | 2022-03-01 → 2023-05-31 | 3,153 | 210 | 4.70 | 3.5% | 82.0% |
| E5 | Regressions: recurring-task crash, wrong calendar year, freezes | 2023-06-01 → 2024-04-30 | 2,210 | 201 | 4.64 | 4.9% | 80.5% |
| E6 | Direct card billing and a thinning corpus | 2024-05-01 → 2026-09-05 | 2,797 | 96 | 4.62 | 6.1% | 81.2% |

## 7.4 What changed

**E1 (launch year, 319 reviews, 4.25★).** A small early base that writes long reviews full of requests (`U_REQ_ANY` 42.0%, the highest of any era), above all for a desktop or web version (`U_PLATFORM_REQ` 14.4%). Praise is the lowest of any era (64.3%) and the mean the lowest (4.25★). Early users arrive from the developer's vc.ru article.

**E2 (2020 growth wave and immediate trial charges, 3,356 reviews, 4.62★).** Volume goes from 37 a month to 310 in one month and stays near 300. The rating prompt starts (`REV_SOLICITED` 1.6%). Trial and charge complaints peak (`MON_TRIAL` 3.1%, `MON_AUTO_CHARGE` 2.9%). The Mac app ships in 2020-06 and is sold separately (`MON_PER_DEVICE` 0.8%, its peak). A Korean cluster of reviews about another app lands on 2020-04-05.

**E3 (free-tier cut and the Oct-2021 crash, 3,341 reviews, 4.50★).** The 2021-01 update caps the free tier and drops existing unlocks (`MON_FREE_CUT` 2.6%, `BUG_PURCHASE` 1.7%, both era peaks); 2021-01 is the busiest month of the corpus (372). In 2021-10 an update leaves older iPhones unable to open the app (`BUG_UPDATE` 1.4%, `BUG_CRASH` 1.5%). Any price objection (10.1%) and churn (2.2%) peak; the era mean is the lowest after launch.

**E4 (sanctions and payment workarounds, 3,153 reviews, 4.70★).** The calmest era for the product: praise at its maximum (80.3%), defects at their minimum (3.5%), the highest era mean. The complaint that defines it is not the product: Russian users cannot pay (`MON_PAYMENT_METHOD` 1.1%, its peak), and support arranges card or carrier payment case by case. Trello and Notion users arrive after those services leave Russia.

**E5 (regressions, 2,210 reviews, 4.64★).** Three clusters in six months: the recurring-task crash from 2023-06 (`BUG_RECURRING` 0.7%), the calendar opening a year back from 2023-08 (`BUG_CALENDAR` 1.0%), and freezes in 2023-10 (`BUG_PERF` 0.7%) — all era peaks, with the crash rate at its highest since launch (2.6%). Monthly volume begins to fall.

**E6 (direct card billing and a thinning corpus, 2,797 reviews, 4.62★).** Fewer, longer reviews from veterans (`TENURE_LONG` 4.3%, the era peak). Payment through a Russian card is now praised, while charges after cancellation persist (`MON_AUTO_CHARGE` 1.2%). The requests that dominate are a task time (1.8%), marking yesterday done (0.8%) and statistics; the criticism that dominates is that nothing changes (`NEG_DEV_PROMISE` 1.1%) and that support does not answer (`SUP_NONE` 0.8%). A launch-crash cluster appears in 2026-05.

## 7.5 What persisted

- **Ease and simplicity praise**, `U_EASE` in every era (29.1–34.3%), 2018-10-14 → 2026-09-03.
- **The free-tier cap objection**, `MON_FREE_LIMIT` in every era (2.5–5.1%), 2019-01-10 → 2026-07-28.
- **Unexpected charges**, `MON_AUTO_CHARGE` in every era (0.6–3.1%), 2019-06-02 → 2026-07-25.
- **A time on the task**, `REQ_TIME` in every era (0.9–2.5%), 2018-11-13 → 2026-08-08.
- **A desktop version**, `REQ_DESKTOP` in every era (0.6–6.0%), 2019-03-11 → 2026-06-23.
- **Reminders that do not fire**, `BUG_REMINDER` in every era (0.3–0.9%), 2018-10-22 → 2026-04-23.
- **The rating prompt (from 2020)**, `REV_SOLICITED` in every era (0.0–2.5%), 2020-01-01 → 2026-07-19.

| `U_CHURN` | 1.2% | 1.2% | 0.6% | 1.2% |
| mean ★ | 4.60 | 4.61 | 4.59 | 4.62 |

Removing the burst days moves no headline by more than 0.2 percentage points. Removing the Russian storefront changes two things: payment-access complaints fall from 0.7% to 0.0%, and billing complaints fall; every other Part 0 finding holds in the non-Russian corpus and in E6 alone.

# PART 8 — PRODUCT IMPLICATIONS

Each item cites the findings it rests on. **Immediate fixes** address harms already reported; **experiments** test a hypothesis; **research questions** need data the corpus cannot give.

## 8.1 Immediate fix — make the trial behave like a trial (§0.2, §5.6)

- No charge before day 7; a visible countdown and a one-tap cancel inside the app; a confirmation e-mail with the renewal date (`MON_AUTO_CHARGE` 229, `MON_CANCEL_TROUBLE` 73, `MON_REFUND` 159; #1004, #2448, #12562). This one theme carries 24% of the 1★ reviews.
- For the direct-card route, a cancellation that works without the App Store and that stops retries after deletion (#15123, #14552, #14147).

## 8.2 Immediate fix — honour every lifetime unlock, everywhere (§0.5)

- Restore the lifetime unlock from any receipt, on any device, on the Mac, and after a reinstall, without an annual charge in between (`BUG_PURCHASE` 142, `MON_PAID_TWICE` 47; #261, #5035, #13758). Never show the lifetime buyer a subscription paywall (#3698, #6387).
- Show one price per region and do not re-price within days of a purchase (`MON_DISCLOSURE` 80; #11765, #11829, #14424).

## 8.3 Immediate fix — the regression pattern (§0.6)

- A release check on the oldest supported iOS and on the "show completed tasks" path before shipping; a fast hotfix path. Four clusters in three years (`U_REGRESSION` 296; #5952, #10868, #10974, #11274) produced most of the product's 1–3★ reviews outside billing.
- Widgets that refresh at day change without opening the app (`BUG_WIDGET` 100; #14740, #9687).

## 8.4 Immediate fix — answer the mailbox (§3.8)

- Reviewers praise Telegram and condemn e-mail; route billing and sync tickets to the channel that answers, and acknowledge bug reports with a status (`SUP_NONE` 64, `NEG_DEV_PROMISE` 88; #15042, #13807, #14740).

## 8.5 Experiment — an event time on the task (§0.7)

- Add an optional start time (and duration) distinct from the reminder, sort the day by it, and show it on the widget. Hypothesis: converts the most frequent 4★ request into 5★ and removes the "write the time in the title" workaround (`U_SCHEDULE_REQ` 471; `REQ_TIME` 69 of the 4★ reviews; #14417, #15021, #15142). Guard against bloat: `PR_KEEP_SIMPLE` 49.

## 8.6 Experiment — yesterday, and a monthly habit grid (§0.7)

- Allow a task to be marked done for a past date, let the user set their own day boundary, and add a month view per habit. Hypothesis: the diary users already value becomes trustworthy (`U_HISTORY_REQ` 253; #14305, #285, #14345, #13067).

## 8.7 Experiment — raise the free cap to three habits, and say so on the listing (§0.3, §5.5)

- Reviewers repeatedly propose three or five habits as the number that lets them evaluate the app (#13325, #11204, #14863). Hypothesis: fewer 1–3★ "only two habits" reviews (`MON_FREE_LIMIT` 697) with no measurable loss of lifetime purchases, which are driven by discounts, not by the cap (§5.2). State the caps on the listing (`MON_DISCLOSURE` 80).

## 8.8 Experiment — a web or Windows client, priced into Premium (§0.7)

- The desktop request has held near 1% for four years and is the reason given by several who leave for Things or TickTick (`REQ_DESKTOP` 208, `REQ_WEB` 104; #14722, #12454, #14975). A read-mostly web view would test demand before a full client.

## 8.9 Experiment — soften the rating prompt (§0.8)

- Keep the prompt but change the dismiss wording and suppress it after a purchase, a crash or a support ticket (`REV_SOLICITED` 309; #3464, #628, #14835). Hypothesis: the same volume of 5★ from happy users, fewer 1★ about the prompt and less "bought reviews" suspicion (`REV_DISTRUST` 32).

## 8.10 What the corpus says to keep

- The one screen: today / tomorrow / later with habits on top (§0.1, §3.2).
- Automatic carry-over as the default — but with an opt-out per task (#14210, #15135).
- The lifetime unlock and the seasonal discount that sells it (§0.5, §5.2).
- No ads in the free tier (`PR_NO_ADS`), and a free tier that is genuinely usable for tasks (`PR_FREE`).
- The developer's visible presence: reviewers thank by name and cite fast Telegram support (§3.2, §3.8).

## 8.11 Research questions the corpus cannot answer

1. What fraction of trials are charged before day 7, and is the cause App Store behaviour, a bug, or the direct-card flow?
2. How many lifetime buyers have lost the unlock, and on which path (reinstall, new device, Mac, account change)?
3. What is the mix of lifetime versus subscription revenue, and does the lifetime discount cannibalise annual renewals?
4. How many users write the time into the task title, and do they churn faster?
5. Does the free habit cap at 2 versus 3 change lifetime conversion?

# PART 9 — EVIDENCE APPENDIX

## 9.A Counting rules

1. **Denominator.** Global = 15,176. Star band, era, storefront and purchaser denominators are stated at each use.
2. **Non-exclusive.** A review is counted once in each theme it carries. Percentages sum past 100%.
3. **Codes come from the text, never from the star rating.** A 5★ whose text is a refund request is coded as such and flagged `CONTRA_RATING`.
4. **`MON_PAID` requires a statement of a purchase** (bought, subscribed, premium user). `MON_LIFETIME` additionally requires the lifetime/forever unlock. `MON_VALUE` records a value judgement and does not by itself imply a purchase.
5. **`MON_AUTO_CHARGE` requires an unexpected charge** (before the trial ended, after cancelling, after deletion, or without a conscious purchase). `MON_TRIAL` records any mention of the trial. A general price complaint is `MON_PRICE`; a cap on the free tier is `MON_FREE_LIMIT`; a cap that the reviewer says was tighter than before is `MON_FREE_CUT`.
6. **`OUT_*` outcomes are first-person.** Anticipation is `JUST_STARTED`. `TENURE_LONG` requires a stated year or more of use.
7. **Requests (`REQ_*`) are for capabilities absent at the time of the review**; a broken existing capability is `BUG_*`; not finding an existing capability is `NEG_UI_CONFUSING`; a question about how something works is `MON_QUESTION` or `NEG_UI_CONFUSING`.
8. **Authenticity is never hand-coded.** Only textual evidence is coded (`REV_SOLICITED` when the text names the prompt; `WRONG_APP` when the text describes another product). Name, duplicate-body and burst marks are computed by rule (§9.H) and never used to drop reviews.
9. **Unions are derived, never hand-applied**; mechanical codes (`STAR_n`, `ERA_En`) come from the record.
10. **Signal bands** are computed from count ÷ denominator using §1.5.

## 9.C Validation — 2854 checks, 0 failures

`59-validate.py` output, verbatim:

```
2854 checks, 0 failures
  coverage: 7
  codes: 5
  theme_map: 633
  unions: 80
  mech: 13
  timeline: 12
  semantic: 2101
  lang: 3
```

Coverage checks assert every index and ID; codes checks assert every code is defined and used; theme-map checks re-derive each code's review list; union and mechanical checks recompute them. Timeline checks: the free-tier cut clusters in 2021-01→04 and is almost absent before; purchase failures cluster in 2021-01→03; the Oct-2021 crash wave exists; payment-method complaints are rare before 2022-03 and cluster in E4; the calendar-year, recurring-task and freeze clusters sit in E5; the 2020-04 wrong-app cluster exists; no rating-prompt mention precedes 2020; no one-year tenure precedes 2019-10. Semantic checks require every 1–2★ review to carry a negative, request, monetization, contradiction or noise code, every refund request on a 5★ to be flagged or to carry praise, `NOISE` and `WRONG_APP` lines to carry no other substantive code, and no review to be both just-started and long-tenure.

### What earlier runs caught

1. **Paraphrased or unquotable fragments.** Notes quoting loosely, stylised Unicode, or text containing inner quotation marks were rewritten to exact plain fragments (e.g. #4298, #4694, #7342, #8228, #9181, #12079, #13113, #14277, #14865).
2. **Codes used before they were defined**: `REQ_WIDGET` and `REQ_SOUND` were added to the taxonomy; earlier ad-hoc codes (`REQ_HISTORY`, `REQ_TEMPLATES`, `PR_BADGE`, `PR_INBOX_OK`, `REQ_SECTIONS_TIME`) were mapped to defined codes.
3. **Semantic rules that caught real coding gaps**: four 1★ reviews about the rating prompt lacked a negative code and now carry `NEG_SPAM` (#628, #2166, #3464, #4261); eight 5★ refund requests now carry `CONTRA_RATING`; one `NOISE` tag on a substantive review was removed (#10322).

### What validation cannot check

Whether a code is the *right* judgement. That is auditable only by reading the note on each line of `59-cls/`, which quotes the evidence.

## 9.I Developer and support responsiveness — the evidence both ways

Developer replies are not in the dataset. Support praise: `PR_SUPPORT` **105** reviews, **0.69%** of 15,176 — Emerging signal, mean 4.83★, 2019-02-12 → 2026-06-28, e.g. "Обратился в поддержку, и в течении 10-20 минут решили" *(contacted support and they solved it within 10–20 minutes)* (#7217, `8515045646`, ru, 5★). Developer praise: `PR_DEV` **1244** reviews, **8.20%** of 15,176 — High-priority signal, mean 4.96★, 2018-10-15 → 2026-08-27; reviewers also say their earlier requests were shipped ("как было приятно, что добавили" *(how nice that they added it)* (#13423, `12045031381`, ru, 5★); "с течением времени, все таки внедрили" *(over time they did implement it)* (#14562, `13399770067`, ru, 5★)). Support silence: `SUP_NONE` **64** reviews, **0.42%** of 15,176 — Weak signal, mean 2.03★, 2019-09-19 → 2026-05-26, e.g. "написала в техподдержку - не отвечают" *(wrote to support — no reply)* (#13823, `12422523614`, ru, 2★). Promises or requests without result: `NEG_DEV_PROMISE` **88** reviews, **0.58%** of 15,176 — Emerging signal, mean 3.43★, 2019-11-02 → 2026-03-23, e.g. "Писала разработчикам на счет этого еще год назад, но пока тишина" *(wrote to the developers about it a year ago, still silence)* (#14085, `12701175675`, ru, 5★). Both kinds continue into 2026.
